entries.declaration_header: theorem card_cube (n : ℕ) : (cube n).card = (2*n+1)^3

theorem cubePolynomial_square_coeff (n : ℕ) (k : Wave) :
    (FiniteFourierReality.reflection (cubePolynomial n) *
      cubePolynomial n).coeff k =
      ((cube n).filter (fun j => j + k ∈ cube n)).card

theorem normalizedCube_energy (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ (normalizedCube n).coeff.support,
      conj ((normalizedCube n).coeff k) * (normalizedCube n).coeff k) = 1

theorem overlap_ratio_tendsto (k : Wave) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ =>
      (((cube n).filter (fun j => j + k ∈ cube n)).card : ℝ) /
        ((cube n).card : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 1)

theorem normalizedCube_coeff_ratio (n : ℕ) (k : Wave) :
    (FiniteFourierReality.reflection (normalizedCube n) *
      normalizedCube n).coeff k =
      (((((cube n).filter (fun j => j + k ∈ cube n)).card : ℝ) /
        ((cube n).card : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)

theorem normalizedCube_coeff_tendsto (k : Wave) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ =>
      (FiniteFourierReality.reflection (normalizedCube n) *
        normalizedCube n).coeff k) atTop (𝓝 1)

theorem exists_physical_heat_law (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : FourierCovarianceCriterion.CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    ∃ μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)),
      ∀ k : Wave,
        (∫ x : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3), UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-k) x
          ∂(μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)))) =
            (Real.exp (-((t : ℝ) * (r k : ℝ))) : ℂ)

theorem exists_transition_of_approximate_squares
    (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) (t : ℝ≥0)
    (f : ℕ → Fourier)
    (hf : ∀ n, (∑ k ∈ (f n).coeff.support,
      conj ((f n).coeff k) * (f n).coeff k) = 1)
    (hcoeff : ∀ k : Wave,
      Tendsto (fun n => (FiniteFourierReality.reflection (f n) * f n).coeff k)
        atTop (𝓝 1)) :
    ∃ μ : ProbabilityMeasure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)),
      ∀ k : Wave,
        (∫ x : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3), UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-k) x
          ∂(μ : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)))) =
            (Real.exp (-((t : ℝ) * (r k : ℝ))) : ℂ)

theorem measure_eq_of_fourier_moments
    (μ ν : ProbabilityMeasure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)))
    (h : ∀ k : Fin 3 → ℤ,
      (∫ x, UnitAddTorus.mFourier k x ∂(μ : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)))) =
      (∫ x, UnitAddTorus.mFourier k x ∂(ν : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3))))) :
    μ = ν

theorem physical_heat_law_unique (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (t : ℝ≥0)
    (μ ν : ProbabilityMeasure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)))
    (hμ : ∀ k : Wave,
      (∫ x, UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-k) x ∂(μ : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)))) =
        (Real.exp (-((t : ℝ) * (r k : ℝ))) : ℂ))
    (hν : ∀ k : Wave,
      (∫ x, UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-k) x ∂(ν : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)))) =
        (Real.exp (-((t : ℝ) * (r k : ℝ))) : ℂ)) :
    μ = ν

theorem exists_unique_physical_heat_law (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    ∃! μ : ProbabilityMeasure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)),
      ∀ k : Wave,
        (∫ x, UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-k) x ∂(μ : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)))) =
          (Real.exp (-((t : ℝ) * (r k : ℝ))) : ℂ)

theorem character_convolution (k : Wave)
    (μ ν : ProbabilityMeasure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3))) :
    (∫ z, UnitAddTorus.mFourier k z
      ∂((μ : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3))) ∗ (ν : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3))))) =
    (∫ x, UnitAddTorus.mFourier k x ∂(μ : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)))) *
    (∫ y, UnitAddTorus.mFourier k y ∂(ν : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3))))

theorem heatLaw_character (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) (t : ℝ≥0) (k : Wave) :
    (∫ x, UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-k) x
      ∂(heatLaw r hr hr0 t : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)))) =
        (Real.exp (-((t : ℝ) * (r k : ℝ))) : ℂ)

theorem heatLaw_conv (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) (s t : ℝ≥0) :
    ((heatLaw r hr hr0 s : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3))) ∗
      (heatLaw r hr hr0 t : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)))) =
    (heatLaw r hr hr0 (s+t) : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)))

theorem heatLaw_zero (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) :
    (heatLaw r hr hr0 0 : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3))) = Measure.dirac 0

theorem character_integral_continuous (k : Wave) :
    Continuous (fun μ : ProbabilityMeasure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)) =>
      ∫ x, UnitAddTorus.mFourier k x ∂(μ : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3))))

theorem heatLaw_continuous (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) : Continuous (heatLaw r hr hr0)

theorem heatLaw_tendsto_dirac_zero (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) :
    Tendsto (heatLaw r hr hr0) (𝓝 (0 : ℝ≥0))
      (𝓝 ((Measure.dirac (0 : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3))).toProbabilityMeasure))

theorem heatKernel_apply (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) (t : ℝ≥0) (x : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)) :
    heatKernel r hr hr0 t x =
      (heatLaw r hr hr0 t : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3))).map (fun y => x + y)

theorem heatKernel_character (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) (t : ℝ≥0) (x : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)) (k : Wave) :
    (∫ z, UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-k) z ∂heatKernel r hr hr0 t x) =
      UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-k) x *
        (Real.exp (-((t : ℝ) * (r k : ℝ))) : ℂ)

theorem heatKernel_comp (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) (s t : ℝ≥0) :
    (heatKernel r hr hr0 t ∘ₖ heatKernel r hr hr0 s) =
      heatKernel r hr hr0 (s+t)

theorem heatKernel_zero (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) :
    heatKernel r hr hr0 0 = Kernel.id

theorem stepKernel_apply (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) (δ : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ)
    (past : Π _i : Finset.Iic n, UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)) :
    stepKernel r hr hr0 δ n past =
      heatKernel r hr hr0 δ (past ⟨n, Finset.mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl⟩)

theorem chainLaw_condDistrib (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) (δ : ℝ≥0) (x₀ : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)) (n : ℕ) :
    condDistrib (fun path : ℕ → UnitAddTorus (Fin 3) => path (n+1))
      (frestrictLe n) (chainLaw r hr hr0 δ x₀) =ᵐ[
        (chainLaw r hr hr0 δ x₀).map (frestrictLe n)]
      stepKernel r hr hr0 δ n

theorem chainLaw_initial (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) (δ : ℝ≥0) (x₀ : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)) :
    (chainLaw r hr hr0 δ x₀).map (fun path => path 0) = Measure.dirac x₀

theorem chainLaw_one (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) (δ : ℝ≥0) (x₀ : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)) :
    (chainLaw r hr hr0 δ x₀).map (fun path => path 1) =
      heatKernel r hr hr0 δ x₀

theorem chainLaw_next (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) (δ : ℝ≥0) (x₀ : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)) (n : ℕ) :
    (chainLaw r hr hr0 δ x₀).map (fun path => path (n+1)) =
      heatKernel r hr hr0 δ ∘ₘ
        (chainLaw r hr hr0 δ x₀).map (fun path => path n)

theorem chainLaw_marginal (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) (δ : ℝ≥0) (x₀ : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)) (n : ℕ) :
    (chainLaw r hr hr0 δ x₀).map (fun path => path n) =
      heatKernel r hr hr0 ((n : ℝ≥0) * δ) x₀

theorem chainLaw_character (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ)))
    (hr0 : r 0 = 0) (δ : ℝ≥0) (x₀ : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3))
    (n : ℕ) (k : Wave) :
    (∫ path, UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-k) (path n) ∂chainLaw r hr hr0 δ x₀) =
      UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-k) x₀ *
        (Real.exp (-((((n : ℝ≥0) * δ) : ℝ) * (r k : ℝ))) : ℂ)

theorem heatKernel_increment_pair (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (t : ℝ≥0) (k l : Wave) :
    (∫ z, (UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-k) z - 1) *
      (UnitAddTorus.mFourier l z - 1) ∂heatKernel r hr hr0 t (0 : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3))) =
      (Real.exp (-((t : ℝ) * (r (k-l) : ℝ))) : ℂ) -
      (Real.exp (-((t : ℝ) * (r k : ℝ))) : ℂ) -
      (Real.exp (-((t : ℝ) * (r l : ℝ))) : ℂ) + 1

theorem chainLaw_increment_pair (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (t : ℝ≥0) (k l : Wave) :
    (∫ path, (UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-k) (path 1) - 1) *
      (UnitAddTorus.mFourier l (path 1) - 1)
      ∂chainLaw r hr hr0 t (0 : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3))) =
      (Real.exp (-((t : ℝ) * (r (k-l) : ℝ))) : ℂ) -
      (Real.exp (-((t : ℝ) * (r k : ℝ))) : ℂ) -
      (Real.exp (-((t : ℝ) * (r l : ℝ))) : ℂ) + 1

theorem incrementPairValue_hasDerivAt_zero (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (k l : Wave) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ =>
      Real.exp (-(t * (r (k-l) : ℝ))) -
      Real.exp (-(t * (r k : ℝ))) -
      Real.exp (-(t * (r l : ℝ))) + 1)
      (2 * kernel (fun q => (r q : ℝ)) k l) 0

theorem chainLaw_incrementPair_hasDerivWithinAt_zero (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (k l : Wave) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun t : ℝ =>
      (∫ path, (UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-k) (path 1) - 1) *
        (UnitAddTorus.mFourier l (path 1) - 1)
        ∂chainLaw r hr hr0 (Real.toNNReal t) (0 : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3))).re)
      (2 * kernel (fun q => (r q : ℝ)) k l) (Set.Ici 0) 0

theorem compoundHeatLaw_sum (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (δ rate : ℝ≥0) :
    compoundHeatLaw r hr hr0 δ rate =
      Measure.sum (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal (poissonWeight rate n) •
        (heatLaw r hr hr0 ((n : ℝ≥0) * δ) : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3))))

theorem compoundHeatLaw_character_tsum (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (δ rate : ℝ≥0) (k : Wave) :
    (∫ x, UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-k) x ∂compoundHeatLaw r hr hr0 δ rate) =
      ∑' n : ℕ, (poissonWeight rate n : ℂ) *
        (Real.exp (-(((n : ℝ≥0) * δ : ℝ) * (r k : ℝ))) : ℂ)

theorem compoundHeatLaw_character (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (δ rate : ℝ≥0) (k : Wave) :
    (∫ x, UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-k) x ∂compoundHeatLaw r hr hr0 δ rate) =
      (Real.exp (-((rate : ℝ) * heatIncrementSymbol r δ k)) : ℂ)

theorem jumpRate_zero (r : Wave → ℝ≥0) (hr0 : r 0 = 0) (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    jumpRate r δ 0 = 0

theorem jumpRate_covariance (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (δ : ℝ≥0) : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (jumpRate r δ k : ℝ))

theorem compoundHeatLaw_eq_heatLaw (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (δ rate : ℝ≥0) :
    compoundHeatLaw r hr hr0 δ rate =
      (heatLaw (jumpRate r δ) (jumpRate_covariance r hr hr0 δ)
        (jumpRate_zero r hr0 δ) rate : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)))

theorem compoundHeatLaw_conv (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (δ s t : ℝ≥0) :
    compoundHeatLaw r hr hr0 δ s ∗ compoundHeatLaw r hr hr0 δ t =
      compoundHeatLaw r hr hr0 δ (s+t)

theorem compoundHeatLaw_zero (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    compoundHeatLaw r hr hr0 δ 0 = Measure.dirac 0

theorem noJump_dirac_le (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (δ rate : ℝ≥0) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(rate : ℝ))) •
      Measure.dirac (0 : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)) ≤
      compoundHeatLaw r hr hr0 δ rate

theorem compoundHeatLaw_origin_atom (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (δ rate : ℝ≥0) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(rate : ℝ))) ≤
      compoundHeatLaw r hr hr0 δ rate (Set.singleton (0 : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)))

theorem compoundHeatLaw_origin_atom_pos (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (δ rate : ℝ≥0) :
    0 < compoundHeatLaw r hr hr0 δ rate (Set.singleton (0 : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)))

theorem compoundHeatLaw_not_ac_of_null_origin (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (δ rate : ℝ≥0) (ν : Measure (UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)))
    (hν : ν (Set.singleton (0 : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3))) = 0) :
    ¬ compoundHeatLaw r hr hr0 δ rate ≪ ν

theorem compoundChainLaw_condDistrib (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (δ rate : ℝ≥0) (x₀ : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)) (n : ℕ) :
    condDistrib (fun path : ℕ → UnitAddTorus (Fin 3) => path (n+1))
      (frestrictLe n) (compoundChainLaw r hr hr0 δ rate x₀) =ᵐ[
        (compoundChainLaw r hr hr0 δ rate x₀).map (frestrictLe n)]
      stepKernel (jumpRate r δ) (jumpRate_covariance r hr hr0 δ)
        (jumpRate_zero r hr0 δ) rate n

theorem compoundChainLaw_one_origin (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (δ rate : ℝ≥0) :
    (compoundChainLaw r hr hr0 δ rate 0).map (fun path => path 1) =
      compoundHeatLaw r hr hr0 δ rate

theorem compoundChainLaw_one_origin_atom (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (δ rate : ℝ≥0) :
    0 < ((compoundChainLaw r hr hr0 δ rate 0).map (fun path => path 1))
      (Set.singleton (0 : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3)))

theorem jumpRate_gamma_is_heatJump_covariance (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (δ : ℝ≥0) (k l : Wave) :
    2 * kernel (fun q => (jumpRate r δ q : ℝ)) k l =
      (∫ z, (UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-l) z - 1) *
        (UnitAddTorus.mFourier k z - 1)
        ∂heatKernel r hr hr0 δ (0 : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3))).re

theorem compoundChainLaw_incrementPair_hasDerivWithinAt_zero
    (r : Wave → ℝ≥0)
    (hr : CovarianceSymbol (fun k => (r k : ℝ))) (hr0 : r 0 = 0)
    (δ : ℝ≥0) (k l : Wave) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun t : ℝ =>
      (∫ path, (UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-k) (path 1) - 1) *
        (UnitAddTorus.mFourier l (path 1) - 1)
        ∂compoundChainLaw r hr hr0 δ (Real.toNNReal t) 0).re)
      (∫ z, (UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-l) z - 1) *
        (UnitAddTorus.mFourier k z - 1)
        ∂heatKernel r hr hr0 δ (0 : UnitAddTorus (Fin 3))).re
      (Set.Ici 0) 0

classical_deductions_proved_in_paper: Finite-polynomial graph-core density follows by explicit truncation from the exact physical Z3 generator domain; no separate named physical graph-core declaration is claimed.
Fractional-power conditional negativity is proved by a direct cosine integral rather than importing the formal fractional-covariance proof.
The explicit superquadratic square has a negative evolved value throughout a sufficiently small positive-time interval; the physical source declaration only requires one time.
Self-adjointness and constant preservation follow directly from the real multiplier and the normalized zero mode.
The equivalence proof on the physical Haar cone combines exact finite-square and cone-closure statements.
The actual laws are reconstructed by compact probability limits of evolved normalized box squares, and Fourier density proves uniqueness. This retains original physical Haar normalization.
Countable chains are realized by independent torus increments. Their iterated transition laws identify them with the formal Ionescu–Tulcea law; no continuous-time paths are asserted.
Haar nullity of a singleton is proved by translation invariance and arbitrarily many disjoint translated points, explicitly discharging the conditional source atom theorem.
The bounded Poisson-parameter generator P_delta-I on C or L2 is proved by an operator-norm exponential series. It is a classical deduction rather than a new named Lean generator declaration.
The Poisson one-step increment derivative is an uncentered Gram second moment of one original heat jump; finite-parameter centered covariance differs by the mean product.
